rules_changelog: v1 -> v1.1 (after the first r003 run, before any verdict was reported): seam gaps <= penetration_tol_m (1e-5 m, D58 float32 basis) are INFO instead of failing the no_seam_gap gate; every gap is still listed with its measured width.  No other threshold changed.

v1 -> v1.1 (implementation bug, found on the first r003 run): connection reachability now requires the component joining both walks to hold >= reach_fraction_min of both walks' eroded interiors; v1 counted a doorway sliver / pocket of the far walk as reached.

decision_rules.OCCLUSION: APPROVE when the geometry file hash matches, the mesh is a closed edge-manifold solid equal to its footprint x [base_z, base_z + height] within vertex_match_tol_m, walls agree with the joined shell on every non-boundary sample, every seam gap between solids is <= penetration_tol_m (INFO), and camera-to-floor raycasts over component meshes and over shell + obstacle meshes disagree on 0 non-grazing rays; otherwise FIX.
decision_rules.VISIBILITY_INDEX: Same object-level gates as OCCLUSION (it is the same raycast geometry).
decision_rules.COLLISION: APPROVE when the OCCLUSION mesh gates pass and, for solids intersecting the body band, the penetration into walkable is <= penetration_tol_m; solids entirely above the band are APPROVE with note ABOVE_BODY_BAND; otherwise FIX.
decision_rules.WALKABILITY: Walk: APPROVE when polygon_m equals its mesh (sym. diff <= polygon_match_area_tol_m2, Hausdorff <= polygon_match_hausdorff_m), lies on the floor, is not penetrated by body-band solids, matches floor - solids within its design pre-cut owner region (IoU >= derived_iou_min), and every derived adjacency is declared; otherwise FIX. Portal: APPROVE when the opening is a clear gap of width_m between two jambs, its marker mesh equals opening_m, the crossing joins exactly connects[], and the two walks stay connected for a body-centre disc of envelope_radius_m; when only the last gate fails the portal is REJECT for metric reachability (topology only).
decision_rules.DISPLAY: APPROVE when the geometry file hash matches and the geometry bounds equal bounds_m within vertex_match_tol_m; DISPLAY never feeds inference.
